rules.statement: The progress of prescription is not arrested by the minority of the plaintiffs or the absence of their father beyond the seas.
rules.supporting_quote: the mere fact that his succession passed to the plaintiffs on his death, and that they were minors at the time, cannot arrest the progress of prescription.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 13 of the Prescription Ordinance No. 2 of 1889
